comment: Read from src/Tuner.cpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1. The panel prints Oct, Semi and Fine, and the third jack is printed Fine while its hover text reads 5V/Semi; the division by 60 at Tuner.cpp:96 makes 5V one semitone, so the hover text is the accurate one. The README calls this module Tune while the browser and the panel title both read Tuner and Tune respectively. The menu ranges run to ±7 octaves and ±12 semitones (Tuner.cpp:166 and 187).
